title: Delivery time checker
story: The shop promises a pizza within 30 minutes or the customer gets money off. The till sends your program two lines: how many minutes the delivery took, and whether the customer is a member (`yes` or `no`, in any capitals). Your program prints what the customer gets.

requirements.text: It reads the minutes (a whole number) and the member answer with `input()`.
Up to and including 30 minutes, it prints `On time`.
From 31 to 45 minutes, it prints `10% off`.
Members who are late (over 30) also get a second line: `Member bonus: free drink`. Members who are on time don't.
The member answer ignores capitals and spaces, so ` YES ` counts as yes.

steps: Read the minutes with `int(input())`, then the member answer.
Use if, elif and else to print one of `On time`, `10% off` or `Free pizza`.
Then, separately, print the member bonus if they're a member and the delivery took over 30 minutes.
hints: Order your conditions from smallest to largest, using `<=`.
Clean the answer with `.strip().lower()` before comparing it to `"yes"`.
The bonus needs both conditions, so join them with `and`.

static.fail: Use an if statement to make the decision.
